summary: A boss that watches the hero (actor eyes: dark pupils that lean toward it) and fires its own shape (spinning squares, square bars) and evolves: a hollow square, then four small squares (phase 2, sweeping lasers), then two orbs that fire on their own and a crown (phase 3, a wide laser); its actor, its emitters and a graph that switches at 66% and 33% hp with a telegraph (its shots wiped, pulse, flash, a second of silence).
notes: ONE ATTACK AT A TIME: the graph atk_sq (tools attack_graph) cycles steps - each turns its emitters on for a while (a timer a step, end_<step>), then the next; msg sq_go starts it, msg atk_stop or the boss falling stops it. Two enemy colours: magenta shots, gold for what is big. Each phase: rules toN (hp_below, an edge: the hp must cross the ratio; guarded by hp(boss) > 0 so a boss sent away does not change), teleN (state.enter: stop, clear its own ids, pulse, object.show the next body, timer), teleN_snd (sounds), openN (timer: emitter.set with the new patterns). A new boss = new body ids, new patterns in emitter.set, same rule shapes.
